title: What Comes With Each Tailwise Training Course: Certificate, CGC Evaluation, Materials
content:
Each Tailwise Training course or pack either includes or leaves out three extras: a completion certificate, the AKC Canine Good Citizen (CGC) evaluation, and the course workbook and clicker.

| Course or pack | Completion certificate issued | AKC Canine Good Citizen evaluation included | Fee for a CGC evaluation when not included (USD) | Course workbook and clicker included |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Puppy Training 6-Week Group | Yes | No | 20.00 | Yes |
| Adult Basic Training 6-Week Group | Yes | No | 20.00 | Yes |
| Intermediate Training 6-Week Group | Yes | No | 20.00 | Yes |
| Advanced Training & CGC Prep 6-Week Group | Yes | Yes | 0.00 | Yes |
| Private Training 4-Session Pack | No | No | 20.00 | No |
| Private Training 8-Session Pack | No | No | 20.00 | No |

### By course family

- **The four 6-Week Group courses** issue a completion certificate and include the workbook and clicker. Of these, only the Advanced Training & CGC Prep 6-Week Group includes the AKC Canine Good Citizen evaluation, so its CGC fee figure is 0.00; on the Puppy, Adult Basic and Intermediate Training 6-Week Group courses a CGC evaluation carries a fee of 20.00.
- **The two Private Training packs** issue no completion certificate and include neither the workbook and clicker nor the CGC evaluation; a CGC evaluation carries a fee of 20.00.
